ADM has already awarded a penalty of  less than the maximum prescribed.
Thus, this appeal is liable to be dismissed.
4.0 The milk sample had fat and solids not fat below the minimum prescribed limit in violation of  Regulations 2.1.1.1 and 2.1.10(2) of FSS (FPS and FA) Regulation.
It even consisted of s k i m m e d m i l k p o w d e r i n c o n t r a v e n t i o n o f R e g u l a t i o n 1 . 2 . 1 0 o f F S S (FPS & FA).

T h e L d .
A D M taking into account the nature of violations and other material on record, imposed only a  penalty of Rs. 3 Lakhs as against the maximum prescribed of Rs.5 Lakhs.

4 . 1 T a k i n g i n t o a c c o u n t t h e a b o v e f a c t s a n d c i r c u m s t a n c e s a n d n a t u r e o f v i o l a t i o n s , I d o n o t f i n d a n y r e a s o n t o i n t e r f e r e w i t h the impugned order imposing less than the prescribed penalty.
5.0 The appeal is dismissed accordingly.
